helper_environment.FACTORY_CERTIFIED_PRODUCT_ORIGIN: contract 1.2+ certification receipt product_origin; consumed by trusted write helpers and never exposed to adapters
helper_environment.FACTORY_DISPATCH_LEASE_ID: validated optional ticket lease supplied by the dispatcher
helper_environment.FACTORY_PROVIDER_ACTIVATION: fixed Contract 1.6 owner-local isolated-v1 activation gate
helper_environment.FACTORY_PROVIDER_BROKER_URL: fixed Contract 1.6 loopback TLS broker endpoint

GH_TOKEN.assignment: exactly one optional GH_TOKEN assignment parsed as data
GH_TOKEN.file_policy: owner-owned regular non-symlink file with mode 0600

active_record.contract_1_2_receipt_binding: contracts 1.2 and 1.3 use receipt_id to select an owner-only mode-0600 receipt whose project, kit SHA/tree, product path/tree, contract, and product origin bind trusted writes
active_record.selection: resolved and validated once per invocation

launcher.managed_path_policy: reject every symlink component before physical resolution

concurrency.parallel_execution_gate: the retained product-wide provider lock serializes native subscription, Cursor CLI, and all other legacy routes; only an exact owner-activated Contract 1.6 API route may use isolated parallel admission
concurrency.stale_policy: never reassigned automatically; recover explicitly through factory-kit under maintenance after active-run validation

provider_execution.activation_gate: disabled until a digest-pinned worker image, owner-only provider policy, transactional coordinator, credential broker, provider-only egress, artifact validator, cancellation reconciliation, and legacy barrier are all configured
provider_execution.legacy_contracts: contracts 1.0.0 through 1.5.0 retain interval-wide serialized provider execution

coordinator.financial_accounting: integer micro-USD machine-day, product-day, and ticket caps count active reservations plus terminal charges in the admission transaction
coordinator.unknown_outcome: retain the full reservation and provider slot for explicit reconciliation

credential_broker.transport: host-loopback TLS endpoint reachable only by the trusted runtime; plaintext is restricted to explicit loopback-only tests
credential_broker.proxy_policy: exact owner-configured HTTPS origin and path, exact token-bound model, bounded JSON request, no redirects, and host-side credential substitution
credential_broker.worker_exposure: the trusted runtime consumes the attempt token and relays only the bounded provider result into a networkless worker; tokens and credentials never enter the container
credential_broker.revocation: terminalization revokes the attempt token; expiry, revocation, or request exhaustion fails closed
credential_broker.reporting: token hashes and raw provider credentials are never returned by status

worker.source_transport: sanitized copy-in with no host Git metadata, control state, sibling worktrees, credentials, process namespace, or container socket
worker.artifact_transport: size-bounded copy-out bound to the immutable worker identity
worker.container: ephemeral unprivileged digest-pinned image with read-only root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, PID/CPU/memory limits, and attempt-local scratch
worker.network: none; provider egress occurs only in the trusted host runtime through the configured credential broker

controller.apply_rule: revalidate the exact ticket branch and base SHA, validate protected paths and artifact identity in a temporary index, then apply and commit under a per-ticket lock

recovery.cancellation: persist request before signaling; release capacity only after container removal is proven
recovery.unknown_outcome: post-GO missing or unobservable workers retain reservation and slot for explicit reconciliation
recovery.rollback: refuse while attempts, legacy intervals, broker tokens, or live/unknown workers remain; preserve activation configuration as disabled evidence

provider_execution.legacy_barrier: no isolated-v1 admission while any legacy provider interval is active, and no legacy provider interval starts while isolated-v1 attempts are active

security.profile_credential_source: mode-0600 $HERMES_FACTORY_PROFILE/.env parsed as data and never sourced
public_redaction: quoted, JSON, multiline, and multi-token sensitive-key values
